summary: IonQ filed an 8-K reporting receipt of final regulatory approval to close its pending acquisition of SkyWater Technology via a two-step merger structure. Merger Sub 1 merges into SkyWater, then SkyWater merges into Merger Sub 2, making SkyWater a wholly-owned subsidiary. No financial terms, price per share, premium, or break fee were disclosed in this filing. The transaction was previously announced January 25, 2026, and closing remains subject to satisfaction of remaining conditions. The announcement signals near-term completion; watch for closing announcement and any regulatory condition details.
